scripts.dev:install: docker compose run --rm --no-deps api npm ci --no-audit --no-fund
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @topologia-new/domain && npm run typecheck --workspaces

scripts.db:status: docker compose exec -T api npm run db:status --workspace @topologia-new/api
scripts.test:domain: npm run build --workspace @topologia-new/domain && npm run test --workspace @topologia-new/domain
scripts.test:db: docker compose exec -T api npm run test:db --workspace @topologia-new/api
scripts.test:auth: docker compose exec -T api npm run test:auth --workspace @topologia-new/api
scripts.test:access: docker compose exec -T api npm run test:access --workspace @topologia-new/api
scripts.test:park: docker compose exec -T api npm run test:park --workspace @topologia-new/api
scripts.test:desks: docker compose exec -T api npm run test:desks --workspace @topologia-new/api
scripts.test:racks: docker compose exec -T api npm run test:racks --workspace @topologia-new/api
scripts.test:connections: docker compose exec -T api npm run test:connections --workspace @topologia-new/api
scripts.test:layout: docker compose exec -T api npm run test:layout --workspace @topologia-new/api
scripts.test:layout-editor: npm run build --workspace @topologia-new/domain && tsx --test apps/web/test/layoutEditor.test.ts apps/web/test/background.test.ts
